heading: Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established in the Department a Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office.

tree.heading: Assistant Secretary
tree.text: The Office shall be headed by an Assistant Secretary for the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office, who shall be appointed by the President.

tree.heading: Responsibilities
tree.text: The Assistant Secretary shall serve as the Secretary’s principal advisor on—

children.text: weapons of mass destruction matters and strategies; and
coordinating the efforts of the Department to counter weapons of mass destruction.

tree.heading: Details
tree.text: The Secretary may request that the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of Energy, the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, and the heads of other Federal agencies, including elements of the intelligence community, provide for the reimbursable detail of personnel with relevant expertise to the Office.

tree.heading: Termination
tree.text: The Office shall terminate on the date that is 5 years after December 21, 2018.

notes.heading: References and Construction
notes.text: Pub. L. 115–387, § 2(b), Dec. 21, 2018, 132 Stat. 5166, provided that: “(1) In general.—Any reference in any law, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to—“(A) the Domestic Nuclear Detection Office shall be deemed to be a reference to the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office; and “(B) the Director for Domestic Nuclear Detection shall be deemed to be a reference to the Assistant Secretary for the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office. “(2) Construction.—Sections 1923 through 1927 of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 [6 U.S.C. 592, 593, 594, 596, 596a], as redesignated by subsection (a), shall be construed to cover the chemical and biological responsibilities of the Assistant Secretary for the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office. “(3) Authority.—The authority of the Director of the Domestic Nuclear Detection Office to make grants or enter into cooperative agreements is transferred to the Assistant Secretary for the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office, and such authority shall be construed to include grants for all purposes of title XIX of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 [6 U.S.C. 590 et seq.], as amended by this Act.”
